name: Odin den' iz zhizni perevodchika mangi
original_name: Один день из жизни переводчика манги
source:
Manga are comics created in Japan. But wait! Once it made in Japan than it must be in Japanese language! Someone has to translate them to English! Is one man enough for this? Has team purely business relationships? Whether all simple and clear? Is it true that the process of translating boring??

[From [url=http://onemangaday.dexp.in/]official site[/url]]
translation:
漫画是在日本创作的漫画。但是等等！一旦是日本制造的，就一定是日语的！必须有人把它们翻译成英文！一个人就够了吗？团队有纯粹的业务关系吗？是否一切都简单明了？难道翻译的过程真的很无聊吗？

[来自[url=http://onemangaday.dexp.in/]官方网站[/url]]
